label: Sea life
description: Named marine and freshwater animals, corals and other aquatic life, with recognizable body forms.
notes: Marine animals and corals belong here, alongside a freshwater group for aquarium fish and aquatic amphibians. animal.species holds the broader animal backbone, animal.insect holds terrestrial invertebrates, and animal.mythical holds invented aquatic creatures. Values are singular names with their own a or an so every complete phrase reads naturally; familiar synonyms share one entry. The kind chips combine body form and habitat, so deep-sea animals may also appear under their body-form group.
